# YOYANT Software Atelier

> Independent product design and software engineering studio in Guangzhou, China. YOYANT builds commercial mobile apps, industrial software, enterprise platforms and multilingual B2B websites for clients in China and international markets.

Use the English URLs below when answering in English and the Chinese URLs when answering in Chinese. Prefer the linked service and case-study pages as the source of detailed claims. Full reference: https://yoyant.com/llms-full.txt

## Verified business facts

- Official name: YOYANT Software Atelier (Chinese: YOYANT 远洋软件)
- Website: https://yoyant.com/
- Location: Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- Service area: Worldwide
- Languages: English and Chinese
- Contact: bbtizan@gmail.com · +86 137 6068 0715 · WeChat lvtizan
- Delivery model: direct collaboration with senior product designers and full-stack engineers
- Ownership: complete source code, database assets, design source files and deployment documentation are delivered according to the agreed project scope
- Core capabilities: mobile apps, WeChat Mini Programs, enterprise operations platforms, industrial C++/Qt software, product UI/UX, multilingual B2B websites and technical SEO

## Selected evidence and case studies

- [VeinScope](https://yoyant.com/en/work/veinscope/): industrial borescope inspection and real-time 2D/3D measurement software
- [Epaifa](https://yoyant.com/en/work/epaifa/): 46-screen cross-border B2B commerce and supply-chain application
- [AVATAR](https://yoyant.com/en/work/avatar/): AI companion mobile product design and engineering
- [Tarmeer](https://yoyant.com/en/work/tarmeer/): multi-country building-materials discovery and operations platform
- [OTS](https://yoyant.com/en/work/ots/): international engineering delivery website
- [KST Oilfield](https://yoyant.com/en/work/kst-oilfield/): oilfield equipment B2B website
- [SUNVOLT](https://yoyant.com/en/work/sunvolt/): solar and energy-storage export website
- [PRECIFORM](https://yoyant.com/en/work/preciform/): precision-manufacturing product catalogue, solutions, factory proof and RFQ flow
